title: D-024 Amendment 52 (set Codex reviewer gpt-5.6-sol to MAX reasoning effort) directly conflicts with the PERMANENT owner prohibition D-004-R159 ('no effort key is ever written by the agent, in any file'; restated by D-007 S3.1 and enforced by config.assert_no_effort_key + codex_reviewer.build_argv, which the config.py docstring summarizes as 'the supervisor never passes it'). Two owner directives contradict; the AI may not supersede a permanent owner prohibition on its own.
affects: M0-T146 (D-024 Amendment 52 R767-R773: Codex reviewer max reasoning effort = xhigh, config-driven) - cannot be implemented without writing/passing an effort setting, which D-004-R159 permanently forbids
detail: The owner directed (2026-09-04, 'yes I want it at max') that the Codex reviewer gpt-5.6-sol run at maximum reasoning effort, captured as D-024 Amendment 52 (R767-R773). Verified read-only: codex-cli 0.146.0 has no dedicated effort flag for `codex exec`; effort is set only via `-c model_reasoning_effort=<value>` (values minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh; no literal 'max', so 'max' resolves to the documented ceiling xhigh, which is itself model-dependent and confirmable only on a live call). IMPLEMENTATION CONFLICT: setting this requires either (a) an effort field in a config file (e.g. model_selection.toml [codex] review_reasoning_effort) - REJECTED by config.assert_no_effort_key (config.py:136), which refuses any key containing 'effort' at any depth; or (b) a hardcoded `-c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh` in codex_reviewer.build_argv - which writes an effort key into a repository file (codex_reviewer.py) and makes the supervisor pass an effort setting. Both violate D-004-R159 ('PERMANENT PROHIBITION: no effort key is ever written by the agent, in any file', classification prohibition) and the config.py-documented implementation ('The installed Claude CLI does expose an --effort flag; the supervisor never passes it and no config file may carry one'). D-004-R159 was previously superseded ONLY for the model-pin keys (V1.2 model-identity-discipline, D-004-R740); its EFFORT prohibition stands in full. Note the asymmetry the owner should weigh: R159's original rationale left BOTH providers' effort at model defaults deliberately; enabling Codex effort while Fable effort stays unset (Fable's default is high) is a policy change, and the owner may or may not also want Fable's effort raised. Per directive-compliance section 9 and the owner escalation boundary (genuine unresolvable contradiction between two owner directives), the orchestrator STOPPED before implementing, captured Amendment 52 verbatim, discovered the R159 conflict while reading the code, created this blocker, set M0-T146 blocked, and returns the decision to the owner. Nothing was implemented; no provider call; the supervisor tree is unchanged; tree clean.
exact_human_action: This is an owner-only decision because it supersedes a PERMANENT owner prohibition (D-004-R159). Choose one and reply in chat. OPTION A (authorize the narrow supersession - recommended if you want max effort): reply 'Approved: supersede D-004-R159 for the Codex reviewer reasoning effort ONLY; set gpt-5.6-sol to xhigh (the documented max), high fallback; Fable effort stays at its default'. The orchestrator will amend D-004 (explicit, symmetric supersession recorded in the registry), narrow assert_no_effort_key to admit ONLY the supervisor-set Codex review reasoning-effort value (user-injected --effort/--reasoning-effort stay hard-denied), implement + gate + R247-recert M0-T146, and the live xhigh confirmation + controller reinstall remain owner-gated. OPTION B (broaden to both providers): reply 'Approved: supersede D-004-R159 for reviewer reasoning effort AND set the Fable worker effort to <tier>' (name the Claude effort tier). OPTION C (keep R159 intact): reply 'Keep R159; leave Codex effort at the model default' - the orchestrator withdraws Amendment 52 / cancels M0-T146 and closes this blocker no-change. OPTION D: order anything else (including HOLD, or a different effort tier such as 'high' instead of 'xhigh').
how_it_will_be_tested: On OPTION A/B: an explicit append-only D-004 amendment records the narrow supersession (registry validator EXIT=0, supersedes/superseded_by symmetric); assert_no_effort_key is narrowed with positive (supervisor-set value admitted), negative (user-injected effort still rejected), and mutation tests; build_argv threads `-c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh` with an enum-validation fail-closed + high fallback, proven by RED-on-mutant; the whole supervisor suite is reconciled to its >=1165-test freeze baseline (M0-T039) with 0 failures; independent G3 + G5 + DCV PASS at the frozen head; the R247 recertification runs at the new identity. The live xhigh acceptance by gpt-5.6-sol and the controller reinstall are owner-gated (no session-launched live review). On OPTION C: Amendment 52 withdrawn / M0-T146 canceled; assert_no_effort_key unchanged; registry validator EXIT=0.
